notes.title: Big update 5 : The Pumpkins Keeper (v1.1) is here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone ! Today, I want to talk about a little surprise we have for you! We have made a Halloween themed updated! It is available right now! If you like the game (or not), make a steam review and if you have any feedbacks and suggestions, please make a post in the Steam discussions!


The patch note

New content

This update adds the Pumpkins Keeper scenario! It is a unique scenario where you must protect a pumpkin field from hordes of zombies coming at you! You have multiples ways of killing them and save your precious pumpkins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/60a20022c155d6b36aa68ae457198a65bc532e05.png

As you can see these zombies are coming for you but don't worry, I put some defenses!
You can build traps, mines and barricades! Traps will kill a zombie that walk on it, mines will explode and do zone damage and finally, barricades will block and damage zombies! They each cost different resources and can be placed in several positions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/9a1514852ec9a8802ef16fb604a29ad3dfd58a45.png

Here you can see a mine exploding and killing some zombies! Once exploded, mines will take a lot of time to rearm (be able to explode again). As you can see there are bigger zombies with more than 1 Health Point, there are also fast zombies!


To help you against the horde, you can count on the new building, the Combat HQ. You will need to hire an employee to be able to build defenses. In this building, you will be able to upgrades your defenses, a grand total of 6 upgrades with most of them having 2 levels!
Here is below one example of the upgrades:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/7b1ccc51cf6878152d11d43aa087dc3e57705c8e.png


Small Changes

- When a ship is infected without having any bugs, it will now show the chance of infection instead of just saying "Infected"
- Add small red flags to better show where are the Lighthouse and the Hospital in the Lighthouse Hope scenario
- Morale changes from the Scenario will now be clearer with custom phrases added to the Scenarios where something impacted Morale
- Improve text of Broken Lens event

Balancing

- Decrease from 1 to 0.5 Knowledge when killing a bug with the Hygiene Researches policies activated
- Balance Morale again

Bugs & Performance

- Added VSYNC option in settings
- Remove hammer sound in Battleship scenario when the Battleship was at stage 0
- Fix text car capacity upgrade
- Fix text Improved tools technology


It might not be the last update for the game as we are looking at translating the game in french!
Thanks for reading,
Have a great day!

notes.title: Big update 4 : The Eternal Winter (v1.0) is here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone !
This is the patch note of our last big update : "The Eternal Winter" (v1.0). As said in an earlier post, it is the last major update for the game. Please, consider leaving a Steam review if you like (or not) the game! We hope that you will have fun with the game because we made sure to fill any gaps in content with this update! Old Saves will not be compatible with this new version because of changes made on the maps! If you want to know all the changes, here is the patch note below. We jumped to the 1.0.3 because we had some fixes during beta test.

A long version of our new trailer:
[previewyoutube=rOKPkoLoomw;full][/previewyoutube]

The patch note

New content

Temperature:
- The temperature almost follows a curve which is different in each maps
- The lower the temperature, the higher the city consumes resources

Morale:
- The morale is between 0 and 100, it changes a bit every day
- It depends on many variables like temperature, quantity of resources, recent unloaded infected ships...
- The morale value defines the number of new people you get every month
- The price of resources depends on it
- Below a certain value, you can have strikes
- Above a certain value, your employees work more efficiently
- Added Propaganda upgrade in Security Post that provides a Morale bonus

Siberia scenario:
- It is supposed to be the hardest scenario
- Temperature is lower than the other scenarios and ships are rarer
- It has a specific building: The Expedition Camp. It allows sending expeditions to gather resources in the countryside.

Recycling center:
- Produces Scrap or Antibug
- Work like the Sawmill or Fishing dock
- Takes time to switch the produced resource
- Production adaptation upgrade for lowering the switching time
- Antibug Production upgrade to be able to switch to Antibug
- You can buy only one the 2 upgrades that increase productivity: Streamline Scrap or Streamline Antibug 

Boiler house:
- Provides a heat bonus
- Requires Clear Area upgrade
- Improved Heating upgrade for increased heat bonus
- Comfort upgrade increases employees efficiency by 10%

Headquarters rework:
- Moved Clear Area upgrade from the Sawmill to the Headquarters. So it is available faster than before but since now Sawmill requires it, the Sawmill is available later than before.
- New upgrade Region Mapping for sending car to other cities or go search a Technology Boat
- New upgrade Winter Clothes for a small heat bonus
- Policies

Pier rework:
- Ships are now limited by the dock size
- At the beginning, only ships with 1 box can come
- You can increase the dock size to have ships with 2 or 4 boxes

Ships rework:
- Added Moths for ships carrying Goods
- Added new ship types
- Added 42 new ship numbers
- Added 39 new ship names
- Added 4 new flags categories


New (and updated) technologies:
- Bureaucracy : unlocks Region Mapping and Policies in the Headquarters. Unlocks Propaganda upgrade in Security Post
- Central heating : unlocks upgrades in the Boiler House
- Recycling : unlocks Recycling Center and improve Scrap conversion in Dockyard
- Wires : added a daily Morale bonus
- Medicine : now remove Knowledge cost for Antibug conversion in Pier

Policies:
- Pretty similar to upgrades BUT
- There are 5 categories : employees management, customs, hygiene, construction and city rationing
- You can buy only one policy per category
- Provides unique bonuses like lowered wages, increase the reward for filling a right report in inspection

Events:
- Added 15 new events about weather and seasons
- Added an animation for when the result is random, so the player knows what option was applied
- Updated events to use Morale and Temperature

Life:
- Added travelers 
- Added musician
- Added new skins and caps
- Added new meshes for houses
- Added rain and snow FX depending on the temperature

Artifacts:
- You can now estimate artifacts, it increases the value but costs knowledge
- Crowns category
- Fossils category

Sounds:
- Added a bunch of new musics
- Added new motor sounds for ships

Small Changes

- Added Temperature unit selection button in the Main Menu
- Added Slow mode option when creating a new game (day lasts 3sec instead of 2s)
- The Second Pier has now its own ship cycle making ships more frequent
- We updated the scenarios to add new houses and improve overall visuals
- Added one level for the House Capacity upgrade
- Scenarios about surviving now show the number of days survived
- Lower the camera lag
- Slow motion is slower than before
- Added tooltips to many resources in HUD
- Updated one of the tech ship texture to be less dark
- Added a sign to indicate where the Battleship, the Lighthouse and the hospital are
- Every building with more than 1 employee now use employees efficiency multiplier


Balancing

- Balance most of the wages
- Balance a few events
- Balance some technologies cost and effects
- Balance some upgrades

Bugs & Performance

- Remove dog collision
- Fix Antibug conversion in Pier using Goods instead of Food
- Fix most of the clipping for Artifacts
- Fix artifact category value text


Thanks for reading all of this! It has been a long journey, and the game changed quite a lot compare to the first steam version in November 2022. If you have any issues or feedbacks, feel free to post in discussions!

I hope you will be interested in our next project!
Have a great day!

notes.title: Big update 4 : The Eternal Winter (v1.0) is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
I'm happy to announce the biggest update (again!?) for the game! It will be released in July (we will share the date later). We are sorry for the delay since our last update.
It's called The Eternal Winter, and it is currently the last planned major update of the game! This means that it will mark the end of the early access phase! A friendly reminder for the ones out there that didn't buy the game yet, the price will increase by 1$ (from 7$ to 8$).

Seasons and Siberia scenario

First, we added a new scenario called Siberia which you guessed it takes place in Siberia. Since it is a pretty isolated and cold place, ships are rarer than on the other scenarios. The temperature is very low (we will talk about it later), making it very difficult to survive! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/1685a9e0622bc89bb0b64631d42af257bc9dd41e.png

To counter that, we added a special building called the Expedition camp. From which you can send an expedition to certains locations to try to get some resources from there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/db3f026e7cdde140e63928a14141852a231de969.png


Temperature and Morale

Along with the new scenario, we added two features we had in the roadmap for a long time. In order to properly do the Siberia scenario, we needed to add them. As mentioned earlier, the season system which was very simple was replaced by a temperature system. The resources consumed by the city will depend on the outside temperature, for example, if it is very cold there will be a lot of goods consumed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/7aba06c2bff842da711637f12628eb8014dbf596.png

Moreover, we added a lot of weather based events (15 new events), with some requiring specifics temperature (or a season) to happen. Also, just to add some cool visuals, we added rain and snow which will enhance the immersion of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/8189462587f9bb97898e7ae47421fc10f9d4bdcd.png

Alongside the temperature system, we added the city Morale. This is a value that is between 0 and 100. Around 0, people will strike and protest, putting the player in a difficult situation. Near 100, you will gain more people each month, you will sell your resource at a higher price and employees will be more efficient! The morale changes a bit every day. It is based on the recent events and current situation of your port/city. It will look at the temperature, the quantity of resources stored, the last date of delivery, if someone died... For example, if you recently lost a part of your population, you will probably lose a bit of morale every day until people forgot about it. They might forget quicker if you feed them well ;). Each scenario also have a small bonus/malus to adapt the difficulty to that said scenario.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/9b870114c046623cd3247b1ddeaaa00fa296328e.png

New buildings and update to existing ones!

To complement the temperature system, we added a new building linked to that called the Boiler house! The Boiler house produces heat in winter which reduce goods consumption and by keeping your people warm you increase their morale! The building also have an upgrade which will increase the comfort of your employees, making them more efficient!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/d2605fe3ddc740f4596f3226e6c999d93a75df8f.png

The second building we added is the Recycling center. It produces some scraps or antibug every few days. Moreover, it can specialize in producing one of the two resources to increase the output of that said resource.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/8e105259e168ff28005b6ffc901b4a292db1186e.png

Enough about the new buildings,let's talk about the updates we made to existing ones. First, we updated the Security post with a second upgrade called Propaganda that increases Morale.

Then we updated the Pier to improve the progression by adding an upgrade that will increase the size of the dock. By doing so, you will be able to unload bigger ships with more resources! Also, with the newly added Recycling center, we remove the upgrade allowing to produce antibug from the Pier and the one allowing to produce scraps from the Dockyard. You can still convert resources in these buildings like before.

We made a small change to the House, we added one more level for the Capacity upgrade, and we added new 3D models to improve visuals.

Finally, we changed a lot of things in the Headquarters, we added upgrades: Region mapping (will talk about later), Winter clothing, and we moved Clear area from the Sawmill to the HQ in order to improve game progression. But that's not all, we added Policies in the HQ. Policies are decisions you can take depending on your situation and can be reversed at will. You can apply only one policy for each category. There are 5 categories, with at least 3 possible policies for each category.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/1417b37c95bedb7f868188a82ff13c0a7544f8ec.png

Progression rework

As mentioned earlier, to improve the feeling of progression of the game, we did some big changes. We added the Dock size upgrade in the Pier, so players will be able to gain more resources from ships with time goes on. 

We moved Clear area upgrade from the Sawmill to the HQ, making it more accessible. Forestry tech which unlocks the Sawmill will now require the Clear Area upgrade.

When talking about the new upgrades of the HQ we mentioned Region mapping, this upgrade will allow sending horse/car to other cities (it was previously possible without an upgrade). But more importantly, it allows calling a Mobile Technology Center (the technology boat) with the horse/car in exchange for a lot of time and some money. It fixes a big issue in the game where you could be stuck because the boat was not coming.

To reflect all these changes, we updated the Tech tree to add new technologies about the new buildings and mechanics. We also have updated some technologies to add more effects to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/02a7dcfe985c6ef79dd1a0e4b0491273977d1680.png

The cool little details

Since it is the last update of the game, we wanted to improve every aspect of the game! So, we updated visuals for all maps by adding props, new houses. We also added some new life outside the port that can be interacted with: travelers, people moving around in town, musicians, wolf pack...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/0443afc6f47ff57a4dac127716f08c14ecd6c31d.png

For a long time, we wanted to make choices of events with randomness more clear on whats happening/will happen. Before, you were only able to see your resources change if you looked at it. Now there is an animation that shows which option is selected, making it clearer and more satisfying. We took the time to add/improve tooltips to various part of the game in order to make things clearer. You can now hover resources in the UI and you will see information about them.

We had some complaints about the game being too fast, so we added a Slow Mode option before launching a scenario, which makes the game a bit slower.

New Content

As stated above, we wanted to improve every part of the game, and adding more content is important for replayability and immersion. 
So we added:
 Moths on ships that carry Goods
 New ship models for the procedural generation
 A bunch of new names, flags, numbers for ships
 New musics
 A few new achievements
 New artifacts


Thank you for reading the patch notes for The Eternal Winter update and have a great day.

notes.title: Big update 3 : The royal missions (v0.8) is here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone !
This is the patch note of our third big update : "The royal missions" (v0.8). Old Saves will not be compatible with this new version! This time we have a video to showcase the new features!
We have a small video showing the new features! For a more detailed version, please read the patch note below. 

[previewyoutube=SYhyFbUHick;full][/previewyoutube]

The patch note


New content

New scenario system:
- 4 new scenarios (+Tutorial and Sandbox)
- Each scenario has its own missions to do in order to finish it
- They have specific events
- They also have a specific difficulty, starting resources, buildings etc.
- The save system was updated to be able to work (that's why they are not compatible)
- Peaceful city : An easy scenario for discovering the game
- Librarian : A scenario where you need to get all artifacts of the game
- Battleship : A scenario where you need to construct a battleship
- Lighthouse hope : A scenario where you need to make a vaccine to stop the disease from spreading

Battleship scenario:
- The Battleship has 10 steps, 8 construction steps, 1 refueling step and 1 step where you send the ship. Once you have done all the steps, you win
- Steel Sheets : Used in events and for constructing the battleship. Can be obtained in the Military Factory
- Military Factory : a new building used for producing Steel Sheets
- Oil : Used in events, for refueling the battleship and for producing Steel Sheets in the Military Factory. Can be obtained in the Oil Well
- Oil well : a new building that produces Oil. It has one upgrade
- 6 special events, including 1 where the battleship will be damaged

Lighthouse scenario:
- A lighthouse : Like the battleship, the construction is divided into several steps. Once you have done all of them, you can call for scientists to come and help you to make a vaccine.
- An hospital : It has 2 construction steps. Then once scientists have arrived in your city, you can develop the vaccine in it
- Vaccine : it takes a lot of time developing it, but you can speed up the development by providing some resources
- Disease propagation level: a new resource that must be minimized. The higher it is, the more people will die from the disease. There will regularly be events that will try to increase it, but if you have enough resources you will be able to not increase it or even reduce it
- 7 new special events

New resource Antibug:
- Used to kill bugs on the ships
- Used in 4 new events available in all scenarios
- Can be produced by transforming food and knowledge in Pier
- Can be produced automatically in Pier by buying a new upgrade

Rework of bug system:
- More frequent
- Can spawn almost anywhere on the ship 
- Can be killed by using Antibug (clicking on them)
- They have 1 to 3 HPs (1 Antibug per HP)
- They can be 1, 2 or 3 on the ship
- Fully animated (movement, hit, death)
- They shine in very easy and easy difficulties
- Scannerbugs : scan the ship to reveal every bugs on it. It requires the Improved Tools technology
- Update the inspection menu to reflect this change
- Update the tutorial
- Always spawn bugs on boxes during tutorial

Steam achievements:
- 40 achievements
- 1 achievement for finishing each scenario
- At lest 1 achievement for each core gameplay features such as inspecting ships, upgrading buildings, etc.
- Some about doing specific actions

Security Box:
- A new building that increases fighting capabilities
- Has a Dog upgrade

Rework of the event system:
- They can have conditions in order to be able to spawn
- Some of the old events now have a condition
- Thief event can only spawn if you don't have the Security Box
- Combat training can only spawn if you have the Security Box
- 26 new events in total with 7 new spawning in all scenarios
- There are 3 new events about fishing that requires you to have the fishing dock
- 4 new events using Antibug resource



Changes
- Press "Escape" to close the opened menu
- Add a Food expiration indicator for storage
- Add expiration summary when selecting storage
- Add progress bar for telegraph deliveries
- Add indicators for when a building produces resources
- Technology boat don't come when you have unlocked all technologies
- Now, each month you will more people if you have resources in stockpiles: Less than 15 resources combined you will get 0, 1 or 2 people; Between 15 and 40 you will get 1, 2, 3 or 4 people; Over 40 you will get 3, 4, 5 or 6 people
- You can't get scrap from filling a good report, instead they will spawn on the ship
- Add one new level to upgrades in Factory
- Replace story menu with a loading screen

Balancing
- Balance events and event difficulty over time
- Used the new conditions for events to make some events happening only when player can handle them. 
- Changed cost for some upgrades
- Slightly increase money gain from deliveries
- Changed time of upgrading for some upgrades
- Changed car maintenance upgrade to make it more useful
- Added a second level to upgrades in factory
- Changed city consumption : it is lowered at the start, and it increases over time (from 0.72 resources per day to 0.38 at game start)
- Changed city storage
- Improved some upgrades effect
- Change cost for disinfection of ships (50->20)
- Brain are not good with probabilities, so to improve player feeling about them, now, when a ship has 40% chance of infection it has in fact 30% chance. The higher the %, the closer to reality it will be (by 60% it will be 60%)


Bugs & Performance
- We improved performance of water during inspection for low and medium presets
- Fix events spawning when you click on a building
- Fix horse outline
- Fix scraps resources not saving
- Fix artifacts status (inspected/sold) not saving
- Fix various texts and buttons
- Fix Steam VR opening when launching the game
- Fix white water during inspection when on low graphics
- Fix Car breaking time

Thanks for reading all of this, I hope you will like this update!
If you have any issues or feedbacks, feel free to post in discussions!
Have a great day!

notes.title: Big update 3 : The royal missions (v0.8) is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
I'm happy to announce the biggest update of the game yet! It will be released soon!
It is called The royal missions, and it is the version 0.8 of the game. 


The scenarios

The game currently has a just a tutorial and a survival mode. 
With this update, the game will have 4 new scenarios with different maps and goals!
You will unlock them by successfully finishing a scenario. Each of the scenarios have a different setup (resources, buildings, ...). They also have special events and features!
The 4 new scenarios are :
[olist]
 Peaceful city : An easy scenario for discovering the game
 Librarian : A scenario where you need to get all artifacts of the game
 Battleship : A scenario where you need to construct a battleship
 Lighthouse hope : A scenario where you need to make a vaccine to stop the disease from spreading
 One scenario will be added in a future update
[/olist]
I will present the battleship scenario with more details because it is a very interesting one! 


Battleship scenario

In this scenario, you have 2 special resources : oil and steel sheets. 
Steel sheets can be obtained through a special version of the factory : the military factory. Steel sheets are very important because they are needed to construct the battleship! You will have 10 events (=steps of construction) to do in order to construct the battleship!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/972333e35aaff03b6de1de69e935f656e0a59ac6.png

Oil can be obtained by unloading ships, some events or, through a special building : the oil well. Oil can be used for making steel sheets and most importantly for refueling the battleship when it has been constructed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/1f2a8e0434a51bd67336a2819853301407f82f75.png

Once you constructed it, you will have the mighty battleship ready to sail!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/bc4087dcf21da7140867aa3e680727440b59418a.png

Steam achievements

We are adding 40 achievements to the game! They are very diversified, for some you need to construct a building, for some you need to select a specific choice in events, etc... Some are unlocked just by playing /progressing in the game.

Two examples of achievements, so you can see the style (old stamps):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/3e630b3d246ec4920af026ae9c814fcb9997cfc1.png
This is the "Business is business" achievement, to unlock it, you will need to sell a collection of artifacts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/d5efb11ae9a354fcbeee4102c58ad823594ab05d.png
This is the "Mechanical horses" achievement, to unlock it you will need to upgrade from horses to cars.


New events

Along with this, we have added new events and updated the event system. Now, events can have a condition in order to be able to spawn. It allows having events for certain seasons or having events that can happen only if you have a certain technology/building/upgrade. 

For example:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/384574e4d012d22c82ce4ac0f715c8420f2c415b.png

This new event, "Shark attack", can spawn only when you have the "Coastal sea fishing" technology and the fishing dock constructed. 


Balancing

We always had trouble balancing the game, and by adding new features at each big updates it has become even more difficult over the time. In this update, we reworked the difficulty system and how the difficulty increase over time during a game. Now, it will be easier for us to change this and maybe find the perfect values. 

Along with this, we did change a few things:

 The city consumption at the start of the game is lowered and increase over time. Making the start of the game easier
 Events were rebalanced
 The increase of difficulty over time has been updated for events too, making them less extreme and at the start of the game and after 1 year
 The boat infection probability has been change to make it less punitive. Ships with 30% chance of infection have now in fact 20% chance (so it is less frustrating for the player). But if you have 60% it will still be 60%. 
 The boat infection probability difficulty has been slightly changed
 Changed slightly, the money gain when deliver a city with few people
 Change city storage a bit
 Updated the system for food conservation, making that the conservation range doesn't increase with fridge upgrades. 
 Used the new conditions for events to make some events happening only when player can handle them. 


And more

We added a new building: the security box. It is available in all scenarios, it improves your fighting capabilities (in events involving combat, i.e. fewer people will die). It also blocks the "thief" event from happening (you need to have a guard, not just the building). Furthermore, it also allows having "combat training" event.

We added the possibility of sending resources to other cities. It allows getting more money and getting money even when the city storage is full.

We improved visual feedbacks for buildings producing resources. We fixed texts and make some clearer, for example the description of the archeology technology now tell for what artifact can be used for. 
We also fixed a lot of bugs.



That's all for today,
Thanks for reading and have a great day

notes.title: Big update 2 : The missing treasure (v0.7) is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we have great news!The second big update of Portobugia called The Missing Treasure is here! This update focuses on improving ships inspection!

The new boat generation system

We updated the way boats are generated. Now, this is a procedural system, it allows for a much bigger diversity of boats without adding too many new parts. Also, ships now have doors and windows that can be opened. Be sure to open them because there can be artifacts hidden everywhere!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/8f7d205ba99cea02a4db869806cb2081870a06f7.png

We added a small feature that inverts the position of the things you need to inspect. As you can see here, the flag and ship name is inverted. The player must pay attention to not fall into this small trap!

Along with a remake of the "Pier". It now has a crane and a beautiful animation with it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/fa0ef5dc1fc38557058f1b594261737db09381f1.png

The museum

The artifacts you gather when inspecting ships arrive in the museum. In the museum, you can inspect them to gain knowledge, or you can just sell them for money!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/daca3b8790a039a07b1aee130069f805b666f8b9.png

The factory

The factory is a new building for the late game. It is unlocked after researching electricity and clearing the forest. As you can see in the picture below (WIP of the interface), the factory will have different recipes with different inputs and outputs. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/ce8e8a9fae936b2cc13acb85d4d65a2a0d9e5966.png

With the factory comes a new resource: Scrap! It will be produced in the factory, the quantity will depend on the recipe that has been selected. Scraps will be used in events and in the Dockyard for repairing ships faster! 

And more

With the addition of the factory and museum, we needed to update the tech tree. We decided to change its overall look to be more cartoony!

notes.title: Big update 1 : The fog village (v0.6) is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Today we have great news! Today, I will present you the first big update of Portobugia called The Fog Village! This update will be released in 1 month! This first update focuses on adding content to the game along with adding a new map to play with!


The new map
This is the current (or old depending on when you see this post):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/c52a10a17b4a39c7474f50fa045aad3297f154de.png

And this is the new map:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/369719f1c633e97185ab0024ee177694a3cc0f5d.png
We have changed the map because we wanted to have something a bit more alive! It also makes it like the port is more real and not floating alone in the void :). We hope you like the change! For us, it creates new opportunities to make different maps in the game. These maps will have a different world around them!

The new tech tree
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/04010cf1631782156357708bdcd3a37742611718.png
The tech tree has changed too, the space is better used and it looks a lot clearer than before! For example, before, to construct the fishing dock you needed to buy an upgrade in the sawmill but with how was designed the tech tree you were not able to understand it. Now it is clearly shown in the tech tree! We also added 4 new technologies: medicine, disinfection, wires, and Baudot. Now, to construct the telegraph you will need to research wires and Baudot first. Moreover, the telegraph has more upgrades! Disinfection is required for one of the new upgrades in the game. The upgrade is also called disinfection and it lowers the chance of infection of the boats that come in the pier (very useful for mid/late game). 

New flags, names, and serial numbers for ships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/36e59ba03a77920a23fb62c2b0885853cecb2e62.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/289c3de12519782d62e3ad7197be1b0ccb8e0647.jpg
We added a lot of new flags as you can see! We hope that it will reduce repetitiveness during the inspection. Along with these new flags, we added new names and new serial numbers.


New events
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42482056/dc7e2a63e01683019915b43e5ea5f5bcc101bcd0.png
The event where a car breaks down now has a picture! Along with this, new broken versions of the car and the truck have been created!
Now, There are events that will have more complex effects than just giving/removing resources! For example, we have a "Strikes" event where employees of the port ask for better wages! You can accept their demands but their wages will increase or refuse and their productivity will be reduced!

That's all for today!
Thank you for reading!
See you!

notes.title: Early access release on the 23rd of November!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have some big news! The game is about to release in early access on the 23rd of November! The game will have a new trailer to better represent the current state of the game! And I want to tell you some details about the early access release! 

But for now we have a small teaser:
[previewyoutube=fQ3MVSe6Oi4;full][/previewyoutube]

I wanted to talk about the early access and what we plan to do with it. First, to be clear, the game is not yet finished! So we will update it with free updates in the next month. We will add new features such as weather and seasons (along with new buildings and technologies related to that), a decree system along with a morale system to add more flexibility and choice to the player. If players like the game and want more content, we have others ideas such as scenarios where we have differents levels with their own specificities. All of this will add replayability and it will make the game more deep and complex!
